messages:
maya: Heads up—our eval dashboard just tripped on the quantized-13B nightly. Rouge-L dropped ~15% for the translation suite after the CI deploy at ~1719993000. Looks like reporting silence + metric dip.
aj: ugh. did you see any test failures in CI or just the aggregate metrics? link? :eyes:
maya: only the eval CI aggregate. CI jobs passed. dashboard: https://internal.redwood/evals/dash/quant-13b/translation — spike at 1719993200.
liam: can you run a quick runner bisect? last infra change was the continuous batching tweak + a tiny runtime patch for KV prefetch.
maya: on it. running: ```runner-bisect --since=2026-03-15 --until=main --test=translation-suite --target=quantized-13b```
runner-bot: bisect job queued (job id 382). will post updates to this thread.
aj: also check tokenizer and tokenization deps—we had a microfix 2 days ago that changed special-token normalization. sometimes messes with BLEU/Rouge.
sophia: noted. I can repro locally with the same prompt set. running: ```python -m evals.run --model=redwood/quant-13b-q4 --prompts=tests/translation/smoke.jsonl --seed=42 --no-stream``` will report exact scores.
liam: log snippet from one failing run shows this in runner stdout: ```2026-03-02T03:12:45Z [runner] kv-cache: evicted prefix len=0, expected>0
2026-03-02T03:12:45Z [model] attention: got seq_len mismatch (expected 512, got 0)
2026-03-02T03:12:45Z [eval] output: ""```
maya: that looks like a KV/cache boundary causing empty outputs, which explains silent metrics. could be the batching tweak that coalesces zero-len inputs.
aj: if it's KV eviction causing empty outputs, that could be the runtime change. suggestion: roll the runtime back on canary pods and re-run the nightly.
sophia: agree. also will run with the earlier tokenizer wheel to rule that out: `pip install tokenizer==0.9.4` then re-run.
runner-bot: bisect job 382 updated: candidate range narrowed to commits 76a1..81f4 (runtime batching + kv-prefetch).
liam: 76a1 is the batching change. 81f4 is unrelated packaging. seems likely. maya, can you trigger a canary rollback for the eval cluster to r-2026-03-18-7?
maya: initiating rollback now. ```curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/rollback -d '{"cluster":"eval-quant","target":"r-2026-03-18-7"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer *****'```
deploy-bot: rollback started for eval-quant -> r-2026-03-18-7. will report status.
aj: while rollback runs, sophia, share the local repro scores so we can confirm whether tokenizer diffs are relevant.
sophia: local run with tokenizer==0.9.4: Rouge-L back to baseline (within noise). with tokenizer==0.9.6 (current): drop reproduces. so tokenizer change is a contributor.
liam: huh, that points to two simultaneous regressions: tokenizer normalization + runtime batching exposing empty prefix handling. unfortunate timing.
maya: deploy-bot reports: rollback completed at 1719994600. re-triggering nightly smoke for quant-13b cluster.
deploy-bot: canary smoke job started (job id 383).
runner-bot: bisect job 382 result: failure correlated with commit 76a1 (batching coalescer) when combined with tokenizer 0.9.6.
aj: decision: hold the runtime batching rollout and pin tokenizer to 0.9.4 for the next eval-nightly. open a rollback PR for tokenizer dep in the eval image.
sophia: filing PR now. will also add a targeted unit test for token normalization edge-cases.
maya: creating release-blocker ticket and will add postmortem template. ticket: https://issues.redwood/ENG-ML-2026. assign liam + sophia.
liam: i'll own the runtime fix (make batching avoid zero-len coalescing) and add an integration test for KV boundaries. ETA EOD tomorrow.
aj: thanks all — keeping nightlies on hold until follow-ups. log a short blameless postmortem once fixes land. :thumbsup:
